tasks.prompt: Starting a RepoScope session becomes unnecessarily expensive on large repositories because the whole repository is read and tokenized just to establish the baseline. Make session startup use a fast repository-size/token estimate without reading every file's contents. Preserve the existing session result contract and token-budget semantics.

Within one RepoScope session, source delivered by repo_context must participate in the same deduplication state as repo_read. After repo_context delivers a file, a later repo_read of that same file must return it as already_read and must not charge the session source budget again.

repo_search can return hundreds of paths for broad terms, which creates avoidable context overhead. Add a caller-configurable result limit with a safe default of 20 and a hard maximum of 100. The returned result list must respect the requested limit.

The TypeScript validation currently misses the MCP .mts entrypoint. Make the normal TypeScript typecheck configuration include the MCP .mts source files so MCP compile errors cannot silently bypass CI/type checking.

repo_search must obey the same AI-readable repository boundary as repo_read/context. Search results must not expose files that the scanner rejects, including files larger than the configured maximum AI-readable file size.
